# 88. Att dräpa sina drakar

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-09-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is mostly a philosophical, off-the-cuff bar conversation recorded after the hosts appeared on DI TV. They talk about fear, motivation, the idea of 'slaying your dragons', whose advice to trust in markets, and how 2012-2021 small-cap fund inflows and zero rates made quality-growth multiples look reliable when they no longer are. They say most stocks are not interesting cases (maybe 5% are live) and add a cynical take on finance-industry relationships and pre-close calls; very few specific stock views are given.

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host says in passing that he likes the company very much.

#### Reasoning

A passing positive comment from the host, made while telling an anecdote about a fund-manager friend who uses snus daily. The name was transcribed as 'Hype' and is likely Haypp. There is no thesis, valuation or catalyst, so this is only a weak watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the host changes his view
- if nicotine pouch regulation worsens

> *"Jag tycker om Hype väldigt mycket, det bolaget."*

### ⛔ AVT-B — Avtech | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host is stuck in the position, says he always hated the company and that it slipped out a warning at 17:15.

#### Reasoning

The host tells this as a self-critical story about buying the dip in a company he dislikes after it quietly issued a warning. It shows a negative view of the company's quality and communication, but it is a trading confession, not a formal recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the company's guidance and communication improve

> *"Jag sitter fast i Avtech i två veckor och så bara kollar jag mig själv i spegeln och bara... Ditt jävla mongo. Du har hatat det här bolaget alltid."*
